Helen Newman Hall Bowling Center Hours

Regular SemesterHours*
MondayClosed
Tuesday5:00pm - 10:00pm
Wednesday 8:00pm - 10:00pm
Thursday7:00pm - 11:00pm
Friday5:00pm - 11:00pm
Saturday3:00pm - 11:00 pm
SundayClosed

*Hours are subject to change. 

Amenities

  • Lounge  
    • Outside food is permitted
    • No outside drinks are permitted with the exception of juice boxes for children's parties
  • Tuesday 
  • Friday and Saturday Disco lights upon request
  • Claw games
  • Jukebox
  • Personalized Service

Individual Rates

Individual Open-Play Rates. Credit card only.

CategoryFee
Individuals$5 per game
Seniors & children under 12$4 per game
Shoe Rental$4

Group Reservation Information 

Reservations must be made one week in advance.

Group Lane Rental Rates (not to exceed 5 people per lane). Tuesday through Saturday—$30 per lane/per hour ($120 minimum).  Reservations are not final until requestor receives confirmation e-mail.

Note: Latex Balloons are not permitted for parties due to a latex allergy within the bowling staff.

To reserve lanes for groups (ex. unit/division celebrations, birthday parties):

Bowling Reservations

The maximum facility capacity is 60. Reservations must be cancelled 48 hours in advance or you will be billed for the reservation in full. No exceptions.

Special Services

  • Sanctioned leagues for men, women and couples on Wednesdays 5:45pm-8:00pm. Individual bowlers who would like to be on a league team are welcome to contact us, as are existing teams that would like to join one of our leagues.
  • Bumper bowling for children (reservations suggested)

  • Fund raising events for non-for-profit organizations
